Maria (sec-eng): FYI: scheduling a coordinated base-image rebuild next Tue 03:00 UTC. Goals: strip all setuid/setgid, tighten seccomp profile, enable cosign provenance annotations. We need RBAC for signing, KMS grant updates, and audit-event plumbing before we cut.
Raj (platform-sre): Understood. Which KMS key path are we using so I can scope the IAM binding? GCP KMS needs the cryptoKey resource in the condition.
Kevin (infra): Using gcpkms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/image-signer. Dev question: are we using HSM-backed keys or standard Cloud KMS?
Maria (sec-eng): Cloud KMS (HSM not required for this rollout). Retention reqs: staging 90d, prod 365d. Also we want minimal privileges: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter for builder SA + signer operator. No keyAdmin.
Raj (platform-sre): I'll prepare a TF snippet with a conditional binding limiting member and resource; will post PR. Example member list: ci-image-builder@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com and signer-operator@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com.
Nate (runtime): Runtime needs to consume the cosign provenance header. If verification fails, runtime should revert to pinned base-image v3.2 for a default 5m window and emit a high-severity alert to PagerDuty. Also include verification.failure flag in logs for forensics.
Maria (sec-eng): Good. Also update central-audit to ingest an "image.signed" event with fields: kms_key, signer, image_digest, build_id, timestamp. @Raj can we have the builder pipeline POST to /audit-intake?
Raj (platform-sre): Yes. I will add a build step that posts compact JSON to central-audit. PR will include payload example and the terraform RBAC diff.
Kevin (infra): Docs note: cosign verify example and how to reference GCP KMS key. Sample: cosign verify --key gcpkms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/image-signer gcr.io/redwood/base@sha256:abcd1234
Kevin (infra): Also I'll draft a key-rotation playbook: emergency revoke -> generate new key -> update bindings -> re-sign recent images -> update runtime trust anchors. Include timeline estimates and rollback guidance.
Nate (runtime): I'll run staging canary with 10% traffic and intentionally break signature to validate revert path. Will post logs and steps in #eng-runtime.
Maria (sec-eng): Action items: Raj -> RBAC + webhook PR; Kevin -> cosign docs + rotation playbook; Nate -> canary validation and revert test; I'll run a vuln scan after rebuild and confirm audit events show up. Tag me on PRs. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: base-image-rebuild -> Tue 03:00 UTC; canary=10%; rollback_enabled=true.
Raj (platform-sre): Posting PR shortly. Will include IAM condition snippet to limit use to the key resource and signing service accounts.
Kevin (infra): Reminder: do not grant roles/cloudkms.admin or roles/cloudkms.signer to any CI SA. Keep to encrypter/decrypter only.
Maria (sec-eng): If anyone sees containerd attestation quirks vs dockerd, call it out now. We want a clean cutover with clear forensic traces.
Nate (runtime): Acknowledged. I'll coordinate with Kevin for the runtime config changes pre-cutover.
Maria (sec-eng): Closing for now; keeping this thread pinned for coordination and audit trail.
